title: Submeter Test Tolerances, Test Fee and Correction Periods — Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
Meter services figures for resident-requested submeter tests on the Utility Pass-Through Service. There is no meter on the Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule, so its row carries no figures.

## Figures by schedule

| Service schedule | Water meter tolerance (percent either way) | Gas, propane or electric meter tolerance (percent either way) | Meter test fee (USD) | Over-registration refund look-back (billing periods before test date) | Under-registration back-bill limit (billing periods before test date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Submetered Water Schedule | 1.50 | not applicable | 35.00 | 12 | 3 |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | 1.50 | not applicable | 35.00 | 12 | 3 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | 1.50 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 12 | 3 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | 1.50 | 2.00 | 40.00 | 12 | 3 |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 1.50 | 2.00 | 45.00 | 12 | 3 |

## Definitions

- **Water meter tolerance**: the largest deviation from true volume at which a tested water submeter is considered accurate, in percent either way.
- **Gas, propane or electric meter tolerance**: the largest deviation at which a tested energy submeter is considered accurate, in percent either way; it does not apply where no energy service is submetered.
- **Meter test fee**: the fee for a resident-requested meter test, charged only when the meter tests accurate.
- **Over-registration refund look-back**: the largest number of billing periods, counted back from the test date, refunded when a meter over-registers.
- **Under-registration back-bill limit**: the largest number of billing periods, counted back from the test date, back-billed when a meter under-registers.

## Boundary reading (hypothetical test results)

| Measured deviation of a water meter | Within the 1.50 percent tolerance? |
|---|---|
| over-registering by 1.50 percent | Yes (at the tolerance) |
| under-registering by 1.40 percent | Yes |
| over-registering by 1.60 percent | No |
